QuestInfo.name: BFFs
QuestInfo.0: Athena Pierce wants to speak with you about something.
QuestInfo.1: Find Kyrin on the Nautilus, the big ship at Nautilus Harbor to the right of Six Path Crossway. Kyrin hangs out in the Navigation Room.
QuestInfo.2: You met Kyrin, the captain of the Nautilus, as Athena Pierce requested.

0.0: Hello, #h0#. Would you be willing to assist a friend of mine? Her name's #bKyrin#k, and she's the captain of the Nautilus.
0.1: She wishes to speak to you. you can find her aboard the #bNautilus#k.
0.2: I believe Kyrin tends to be in Navigation Room. Meet up with her and offer her a help. The Nautilus is docked to the right of the Six Path Crossway. I will transport you to Kyrin right away.\r\n\r\n(Accept to immediately be moved to #m120000101#, where Kyrin is located.)

yes.0: Thank you. You can find the Nautilus on the dock to the right of the Six Path Crossway. You might mistake the ship for a giant whale, because that's what it looks like.
yes.1: You will find Kyrin in the navigation room.

no.0: Kyrin is a dear friend. I do hope you'll reconsider.

1.0: I'm Kyrin, captain of the Nautilus and a Pirate Job Instructor. Who are you?

yes.0: Oh, Pierce sent you, did she?
